subtitle: Lesson 33 · From source file to pip install

code:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(quantlib_cpp LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
add_subdirectory(extern/pybind11)

pybind11_add_module(quantlib_cpp
  src/pricer_module.cpp
  src/payoff.cpp)

target_compile_options(
  quantlib_cpp PRIVATE -O3)
caption: pybind11_add_module wraps add_library and names the output so Python can import it directly.
